summary: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index, which tracks rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, fell by 0.5% to 2,901 points on Thursday, after increasing by 0.7% in the prior session. The capesize index, which typically transports 150,000-ton cargoes, including iron ore and coal, decreased by 0.8% to 4,514 points; and the supramax index edged down by 0.2% to 1,814 points. Conversely, panamax index, which usually carries 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, increased 3 points to 2,132 points.
source: Trading Economics public page summarising Baltic Exchange data
